387537878bc1aad6.title: Most cancer drugs approved by European regulators lack a high clinical benefit, analysis finds
digest: Most new cancer medicines approved by European regulators over a recent four-year period do not offer high clinical benefit and those that do were generated by a small number of drugmakers, mostly based in Asia, according to a new analysis.

Just 31% of 97 approved indications for 63 different cancer treatments offered a high clinical benefit and only nine of those medications received the top grade based on measurement tools used by the European Society for Medical Oncology.

digest: Adults aged 55 to 80 years with %p-tau217 measured before medical and cognitive exclusions (N = 15 612) were included.

Results Among 15 612 participants, the mean (SD) age was 68.4 (6.2) years; 9941 (63.7%) were female and 5755 (36.9%) were APOE ε4 carriers. %p-tau217 levels were lower among Asian, Black, and Hispanic participants than among White and non-Hispanic participants.
APOE ε4 status was associated with higher %p-tau217 across all groups.

c219d5b04f434834.title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Effectiveness of Upadacitinib in Pediatric Participants With Alopecia Areata
digest: Alopecia areata (AA) is a disease that happens when the immune system attacks hair follicles and causes hair loss.

Some treatment options are available for adults and adolescents with AA, however there is still high unmet need for systemic treatments (treatment that moves throughout the bloodstream) approved for young patients with AA.
Participants will receive oral doses of upadacitinib or matching placebo daily, or twice daily, for approximately 160 weeks.

058e05562b1a4433.title: Live-cell imaging of fetal microglia reveals time-dependent sex differences in their responsiveness to prenatal maternal stress
digest: Prenatal maternal stress is increasingly being linked to neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), and across diverse maternal stressors, immune dysregulation is emerging as a common feature.
This suggests that fetal microglia may influence neurodevelopment by detecting changes in signaling from the intrauterine environment.

c188c9852ecef4a3.title: Human Argonaute 2 is a programmable targeting domain for RNA editing
digest: ALTER is a programmable RNA base editor built entirely from human proteins. By using human AGO2 instead of bacterial CRISPR–Cas proteins, ALTER mitigates a key risk factor for harmful immune responses in therapeutic applications while also proving generally more effective than dCas13-based editors.
